architecture.scope: Formal Scripts only; external API compilation verified separately by Unity and CoreBuild

compilation.reasonForSecond: Explicit stable actor de-duplication and additional partial-training/worksite/global-backlog scenarios before final Editor suite.

limitations: Bootstrap, Unity real-time accumulator and WorldSessionBehaviour are not wired to SessionAuthority.
SessionRequest/SessionReceipt are plain business values, not registered wire DTOs. Existing wire/definitions/generation untouched.
Connect and Ready are privileged server-adapter APIs. Tests do not implement FishNet authentication, content handshake, recovery credentials or actual snapshot application.
Frozen world capture is for authority saves/tests, includes RNG, and is not a client presentation projection.
BeginLoad Applied means loading started, not file load success. Production slot IO orchestration, saving/restart commands, completion notifications and UI remain pending.
Transport size/rate limits, Ready/loading timeouts, initial/late-join projection, event feedback and per-actor failure details remain pending.
No Mono/IL2CPP Player build/run, PlayMode, independent network processes, weak network, art or scene changes in this batch.
IL2CPP requires explicit user approval; none requested or performed.
No external Godot or user YYGC repository writes. Existing user AGENTS.md change remains uncommitted.
